card.name: Spots before a name is repeated or listed
card.fires_on: Fires on the last piece of a repeated drug name such as diclofenac or naproxen, just before 'sodium' or 'potassium'. Also fires on small linking marks like '(', 'as' or '=' right before an example or abbreviation expansion.

modes.label: End of repeated drug name
modes.description: Final piece of diclofenac or naproxen when the name is listed again in a series of formulations.
modes.example: (diclofenac sodium enteric-coated tablets; diclofenac sodium extended-release tablets; diclofen<<ac>> potassium immediate-release tablets)

modes.label: Linker before an example
modes.description: A bracket, 'as' or '=' that introduces a named example or expansion.
modes.example: insolubility of many arsenic-containing minerals such<< as>> pyrite under normal soil conditions.

card.plain: It lights up where a drug name is being repeated in a list, or where an example is about to be named.
